## Description

A daily job raises one alert per item below its reorder level and per batch expiring within 30 days (configurable), shown in the notification centre for admins.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** An alert is raised once and cleared when the stock is back above the level or the batch is used up.
- [ ] **AC2.** The expiry window is a clinic setting.
